subject.title: Install ClawHub packages for new Claw agents

question: Should experimental `claws add` be allowed to install or reuse a process-wide plugin after one exact plan-bound consent, rather than limiting this package slice to workspace-scoped skills until a separate host-grant model exists?
rationale: This is a persistent authorization and isolation boundary for all agents in a shared OpenClaw process; the contributor and community discussion state a position, but the provided context does not show a maintainer decision adopting it.

options.title: Approve the bounded shared-host model after proof
options.body: Keep the explicit experimental shared-plugin model, but require a redacted final-head transcript proving install, exact reuse, and safe compensation before merge.

options.title: Restrict this slice to skills
options.body: Defer process-wide plugin mutation and land only workspace-scoped skill installation until maintainers define a separate host-level authorization model.

recommendation.title: Approve the bounded shared-host model after proof
recommendation.body: Keep the explicit experimental shared-plugin model, but require a redacted final-head transcript proving install, exact reuse, and safe compensation before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Their review established the concrete lifecycle and provenance safety requirements for this proposed package boundary.
